name: MCT Oil
siboNotes: MCT oil is well-tolerated and rapidly absorbed in the small intestine, making it less likely to feed bacterial overgrowth compared to other fats.
preparationTips: Start with 1 teaspoon and gradually increase to avoid digestive upset
Mix into smoothies, coffee, or salad dressings for easy incorporation
Store at room temperature - does not require refrigeration
Can be used for light cooking but has a lower smoke point than coconut oil
pairsWellWith: Low FODMAP smoothies with strawberries and spinach
Coffee or tea as a creamer substitute
nutritionalHighlights: Provides quick energy without storing as body fat
May support cognitive function and metabolism
